location_description:
West Islip is a hamlet and CDP located in the Town of Islip in Suffolk County, New York, United States. Situated on the South Shore of Long Island, the population of the CDP was 27,048 at the time of the 2020 census.


== Geography ==
West Islip is located at 40°42′54″N 73°17′52″W (40.715008, -73.297746).According to the United States Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of 6.8 square miles (17.5 km2), of which 6.3 square miles (16.4 km2) is land and 0.42 square miles (1.1 km2), or 6.46%, is water.Great South Bay, Jones Beach Island and Fire Island lie to the south.
